Fuzzer harness that initializes a snapshot manifest parser and feeds it input data.

# Purpose
This file is a libFuzzer harness for the `fd_ssmanifest_parser` parser. [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) sets up the `fd` runtime, allocates aligned memory for a `fd_snapshot_manifest_t` output object and a `fd_ssmanifest_parser_t` parser object, and disables parser error logging. [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) resets the parser for each test case and feeds the input buffer to `fd_ssmanifest_parser_consume` so the fuzzer can exercise the manifest parsing code with arbitrary data.
